[SWS_DM_00947] Occurrence Counter increment strategy ’confirmedDtcBit’
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04105
⌈
If the configuration parameter
DiagnosticCommonProps.occurrenceCounter-
Processing
is set to
confirmedDtcBit
and a certain
event
is already stored in
the
event memory
and the
UDS DTC status bit
"
kConfirmedDTC
" is equal to
’1’, for each transition of
UDS DTC status bit
"
kTestFailed
" from ’0’ to ’1’, the
DM module shall trigger the increment of the associated occurrence counter by one.
⌋
